topbar.toggleDetail: Show or hide the detail panel

library.title: Your library is empty
library.text: Add the folder where your music lives, for example on your external drive.
library.dropHint: You can also drag a folder from Explorer or Finder onto this window.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.text: New tracks dropped into your incoming folder will appear here.

review.title: All up to date
review.text: Tracks with uncertain online information will appear here.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.text: Copies of the same track will be grouped here, with the best version suggested.

health.title: Library health
health.text: Missing artwork, unreadable files, non-matching names: everything will be counted here.

quarantine.title: Quarantine is empty
quarantine.text: Set-aside files will be kept here and can be restored in one click.

playlists.title: Playlists and filters
playlists.text: Your playlists and smart filters will appear here.

folders.title: Folders
folders.text: The tree of your music folders will appear here.

library.noResultsHint: Try another search or clear the filters.
library.notAFolder: This is not an accessible folder.

table.label: Tracks
table.sortHint: Click to sort; Shift + click to sort on several columns

badges.missing: File not found: deleted or moved outside the application
badges.wav: Rekordbox will read title, artist, album, genre and comment, but not the artwork
badges.desync: The two tag blocks of this WAV (RIFF INFO and ID3) disagree

detail.title: Details
detail.hint: Select a track to see and edit its information.
detail.multipleHint: Editing several tracks at once is coming very soon.
detail.lock: Lock (no automation will change this field)
detail.coverDropHint: Or drop an image onto the window

folders.title: Library folders
folders.hint: Folders indexed by the application. External drives are recognised even if their letter or mount point changes.
folders.removeText: “{{path}}” will no longer be followed by the application. No file is deleted or moved on the drive.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
settings.densityHint: Compact shows more tracks on screen.
settings.diagnosticHint: Copies a report (version, system, end of the log) to paste into your message. Nothing is sent automatically.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.database: The application database could not be read. Your audio files are not affected. Copy the diagnostic report in Settings to report the problem.
errors.database_too_new: The database was created by a newer version of the application. Install the latest version to continue. Your audio files are not affected.
errors.database_unavailable: The database could not be opened at startup. Your settings will not be saved. Your audio files are not affected.
errors.io: The application data folder is not accessible. Check that the computer's disk has free space.
errors.invalid_setting: This setting could not be saved.
errors.internal: Internal error. Restart the application; if the problem comes back, copy the diagnostic report.
errors.settingNotSaved: The setting could not be saved.

edit.failedMany: {{count}} tracks were not changed. For example: {{reason}}
edit.selectFirst: Select one or more tracks first.
edit.coverNotSquare: The image is not square: it was kept whole. Cropping is coming in phase 2.
edit.coverUnreadable: This image could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG file.
edit.noImageInClipboard: The clipboard does not contain an image.
edit.locked: Field “{{field}}” locked: no automation will change it

writeErrors.read_only: the file or drive is read-only. Check that it is not write-protected.
writeErrors.in_use: the file is open in another program. Close it and try again.
writeErrors.disk_full: the drive is full. Free up some space and try again.
writeErrors.unsupported: this format cannot be edited yet.
writeErrors.unsafe_tags: its current tags cannot be read back safely, so it was left untouched.
writeErrors.verify: the check after writing failed; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.audio_changed: the audio would have changed; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.io: file access error; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.internal: internal error; the original file is intact.
